cohort: The cohort consisted of 85 cases of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) identified from 9,088 deliveries.
finding: Significant risk factors for PAS included multiparity, prior caesarean sections, placenta praevia, uterine surgeries, and IVF, leading to the development of a region-specific risk stratification model.
mod_finding: Prior caesarean sections were identified as a significant risk factor for Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from September 2023 to September 2024.
